package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestTmpProxyBalancerWithNoTargets(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)

	rb := NewRandomBalancer(nil)
	assert.Nil(t, rb.Next(c))

	rrb := NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)
	assert.Nil(t, rrb.Next(c))

	// middleware level
	e2 := echo.New()
	e2.Use(Proxy(NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)))
	rec2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e2.ServeHTTP(rec2, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec2.Code)

	e3 := echo.New()
	e3.Use(Proxy(NewRandomBalancer(nil)))
	rec3 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e3.ServeHTTP(rec3, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec3.Code)

	// removing all targets then proxying
	t1 := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}))
	defer t1.Close()
	u1, _ := urlParse(t1.URL)
	rrb2 := NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{{Name: "t1", URL: u1}})
	assert.True(t, rrb2.RemoveTarget("t1"))
	assert.Nil(t, rrb2.Next(c))
}
EOF

arguments.text:
Fixed the bug in `middleware/proxy.go`.

Root cause: with an empty target list, `randomBalancer.Next` called `rand.Intn(0)` (panic) and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` did `b.i % 0` (integer divide-by-zero panic), and `ProxyWithConfig` dereferenced the returned target unconditionally.

Changes (only `middleware/proxy.go`):
- `randomBalancer.Next` now returns `nil` when there are no targets.
- `roundRobinBalancer.Next` now returns `nil` when there are no targets (also takes the read lock for consistency with the other balancer).
- `ProxyWithConfig` now checks for a `nil` target and returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (503) instead of panicking.

Verified: `go test ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass (all pre-existing tests green, including `TestProxy`, `TestProxy_1_11`, `TestClientCancelConnectionResultsHTTPCode499`), and an ad-hoc check confirmed both balancers return `nil` with no targets and the middleware responds 503 rather than panicking.

package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

func TestZZGzipEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)
	h := Gzip()(func(c echo.Context) error {
		return c.String(http.StatusOK, "")
	})
	err := h(c)
	t.Logf("err=%v code=%d body=%q ce=%q ct=%q cl=%q", err, rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentLength))

	e2 := echo.New()
	req2 := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req2.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c2 := e2.NewContext(req2, rec2)
	h2 := Gzip()(func(c echo.Context) error { return nil })
	err2 := h2(c2)
	t.Logf("nil-handler: err=%v code=%d body=%q ce=%q ct=%q", err2, rec2.Code, rec2.Body.String(), rec2.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec2.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType))

	e3 := echo.New()
	req3 := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req3.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec3 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c3 := e3.NewContext(req3, rec3)
	h3 := Gzip()(func(c echo.Context) error { return c.NoContent(http.StatusOK) })
	err3 := h3(c3)
	t.Logf("nocontent200: err=%v code=%d body=%q ce=%q ct=%q", err3, rec3.Code, rec3.Body.String(), rec3.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec3.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType))
}
EOF

package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"

func zzRun(t *testing.T, name string, h echo.HandlerFunc) {
	e := echo.New()
	e.Use(Gzip())
	e.GET("/", h)
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

}

func TestZZGzipEmpty2(t *testing.T) {
	zzRun(t, "nil", func(c echo.Context) error { return nil })
	zzRun(t, "string-empty", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "") })
	zzRun(t, "nocontent200", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.NoContent(http.StatusOK) })
	zzRun(t, "html-empty", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.HTML(http.StatusOK, "") })
	zzRun(t, "blob-empty", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, echo.MIMETextPlain, []byte{}) })

	zzRun(t, "writeheader", func(c echo.Context) error { c.Response().WriteHeader(http.StatusOK); return nil })
}
EOF
